'''Karin Baur''' is a Swiss mathematician who is working in the mathematical fields [[Abstract algebra|algebra]], [[representation theory]], [[cluster algebra]]s, [[cluster category|cluster categories]], [[combinatorics]], [[Lie algebra]]s.<ref name=":0" /> Currently she is a professor at [[University of Leeds]]<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://eps.leeds.ac.uk/maths/staff/4250/professor-karin-baur-|title=Professor Karin Baur {{!}} School of Mathematics {{!}} University of Leeds|last=Sciences|first=Faculty of Engineering and Physical|website=eps.leeds.ac.uk|language=en|access-date=2019-11-19}}</ref> and she also a full professor at [[University of Graz]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae Karin Bauer |url=https://imsc.uni-graz.at/baur/CV.pdf |access-date=2023-01-07 |website=Institut für Mathematik und Wissenschaftliches Rechnen, University of Graz }}</ref> From 2007&ndash;2012 she has been an assistant professor ([[SNSF]] professor) at [[ETH Zurich]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=http://p3.snf.ch/Project-114794|title=SNSF {{!}} P3 Research Database {{!}} Project 114794|last=|first=|date=|website=p3.snf.ch|language=en|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-11-19}}</ref> Moreover, she is one of the protagonists of the project ''Women of Mathematics throughout Europe''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://womeninmath.net/protagonist/karin-baur/|title=KARIN BAUR {{!}} Women of Mathematics|language=en-GB|access-date=2020-03-14}}</ref>

== Recognition ==
In 2018 Baur was awarded a [[Royal Society Wolfson Fellowship]] for her work on ''Surface categories and mutation''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://royalsociety.org/news/2018/09/royal-society-and-wolfson-foundation-announce-first-royal-society-wolfson-fellowships/|title=The Royal Society and Wolfson Foundation today announce the first recipients of the Royal Society Wolfson Fellowship Scheme. {{!}} Royal Society|website=royalsociety.org|language=en-gb|access-date=2019-11-19}}</ref>

For her project ''Orbit Structures in Representation Spaces'', she won an [[SNSF]] Professorship in 2007.<ref name=":3" />
